screens.title: 1 · Tempo: the delivery is a door
screens.why: Lista keeps the day and the loose reminders; a delivery's own tasks live on its page.

pins.label: Tap opens the delivery
pins.text: In Lista a delivery's card (DeliveryTile, here in Agora; also in Ainda hoje/Amanhã) opens the delivery's page on Pendentes, not the next task. The controls (pause, −15, +15, ✓) still act on the running task.

pins.label: A loose task opens itself
pins.text: A task with no delivery opens its own page, as today.

pins.label: Ainda hoje / Amanhã: the delivery's name
pins.text: Unchanged: a delivery's tasks in the day are drawn as its card, under the delivery's name, with only the next task beneath it.

pins.label: Para depois: loose tasks only
pins.text: Reminders with no delivery. The delivery's backlog (Revisar a leitura, Enviar para a Renata) is not drawn here and leaves no counter behind; it is in the delivery's Para depois (screen 2). Drops still count the hidden ones.

screens.title: 2 · The delivery: Pendentes
screens.why: Same bar as Entregas, three tabs, and Tempo's own stages over the delivery's tasks: Agora, one day, Para depois.

pins.label: The Entregas bar
pins.text: PaceBars, as on the delivery's row in Entregas: work done in green over time gone in red, with its key (3 de 8 etapas · faltam 4 dias). Replaces the thin red time line; the Progresso row goes, since the key says it. −1 dia / +1 dia stay beside it.

pins.label: Notas · Pendentes · Feitas
pins.text: Three tabs in AppSegmented: pen, clock (AppIcons.time) and check, with counts. The page still opens where it was left; from Tempo it opens on Pendentes.

pins.label: Tempo's structure
pins.text: Agora when one of its tasks runs, then one day only, Ainda hoje or Amanhã, chosen by the hour as Tempo chooses it (_listDay), then Para depois. Fazer em breve is gone.

pins.label: No delivery label
pins.text: Cards here never name the delivery (no tag, no stack mark): the page's title already does.

pins.label: The days after, a line away
pins.text: As on Tempo, the tasks after that day are one line: 'Mais 1 tarefa adiante'. The page has no calendar, so its link is 'Ver os próximos dias', which draws them here under their dates.

pins.label: Its own Para depois
pins.text: Where the delivery's backlog lives now that Tempo's Para depois leaves it out. + and the bar's + write into this delivery, as today.

screens.title: 3 · The delivery: Feitas
screens.why: What was done gets its own tab, last, instead of a stage under the backlog.

pins.label: Feitas, last tab
pins.text: The done stage leaves Pendentes; TimelineList loses its done: parameter.

pins.label: By the day it was done
pins.text: Hoje, Ontem, then the date, newest first: the headings of Menu → Feitas (doneDayLabel, now shared).

pins.label: Archive's tile, no tag
pins.text: DoneArchiveTile: the check, the title, the hour it was done, the start of its notes; no delivery tag. A tap opens the finished task's page.

screens.title: 4 · Calendário: the block is the delivery too
screens.why: A tap on a delivery's block opens the delivery, as in Lista; the hands still move each task.

pins.label: Tap opens the delivery
pins.text: A tap on any line of a delivery's block (here Calcular o mapa, Escrever a leitura) opens the delivery's page on Pendentes. A drag, a nudge, a swap and the seam still take the line's own task; the buttons act on the running one.

pins.label: A lone task of a delivery too
pins.text: Rascunhar o texto is the Post's only task here; its card names the delivery, and a tap opens the delivery as well.

pins.label: A loose task opens itself
pins.text: A task with no delivery opens its own page, as today.
